topics.title: Creating Your First Level
topics.body: Start with a basic playable level first, then add special rules. 1. In Basic Settings, fill in Level Name and Number, select a Map, and set Starting Sun and Total Waves. (Input range: 10–100 waves; start with 10 for testing). 2. In "Spawn Settings", select available zombie types, then go to the Wave Spawns page to configure fixed enemy waves. 3. On the Cards page, configure available plants and seed slots. After modifying costs and cooldowns, click Save Changes on that page. 4. Set the Win Condition. For your first level, use standard Victory; keep special modes disabled for now. 5. Click "Save & Generate Level" at the bottom, then start the game to test planting, zombie spawns, and level completion. 6. Once the basic level works properly, go to the Events page to add prompts, timed sun, reward choices, and custom rules. Event nodes are optional Basic levels do not require nodes. Only use Event Rules when you need "something to happen under specific conditions". Recommended first exercise On the Events page, click "Add Rule Template" and select "Gain Sun Every 5s". Select the nodes to view descriptions and edit values, then save and test.

topics.title: Map, Rules & Win Conditions
topics.body: The map determines the battlefield; rules determine the gameplay. Basic Settings: Level Name, Number, Map, Starting Sun, and Total Waves. Modes Page: Disable natural spawns, sky sun, lawn mowers, or enable special modes like Conveyor, Rain of Seeds, I, Zombie, etc. Victory Page: Choose Standard Victory or I, Zombie Victory. Tips for beginners: Start by adjusting only starting sun and spawns. Test after toggling each mode switch to see how it affects gameplay. "Disable Natural Spawns" stops regular wave enemies; if enabled, you must script enemy spawns manually.

topics.title: Cards & Zombie Spawns
topics.body: Card Settings Configure pre-selected cards, seed slots, and custom costs/cooldowns. Click Save Changes on the page after editing before saving the whole level; unsaved input field edits will not persist. Two Spawn Settings "Spawn Settings" selects zombie types for random spawning. "Wave Spawns" scripts specific enemies and lanes per wave. Both serve different purposes. If unexpected enemies appear, verify random candidates, wave spawns, and event triggers.

topics.title: Pre-placed Plants & Setup
topics.body: Pre-placed Plants & Vases Enter the setup battlefield to place plants or vases. Exit to apply changes to your draft, then save the level. Pre-placed plants exist before event graphs start, so "On Plant" will not trigger for them. To process them, use "Level Start → Get All Plants on Lawn → Iterate Plant List". Planting rules still apply Water, roof tiles, plant carriers, and occupied tiles affect creation. "Create Plant" checks standard rules by default; connect error-handling branches if creation fails.

topics.title: How to Connect Nodes
topics.body: A rule = When (Trigger) → Condition (Check) → Action (Do) Example: "Show tip when Wave 5 begins". Level Wave Advances → Branch → Show Text defines execution order. Wave Count → Int Comparison (= 5) → Branch Condition provides data. Two Wire Types Execution flow: Connects Trigger outputs to Trigger inputs. Without it, actions will not run. Data wires: Passes numbers, text, plant objects, etc. Connecting data alone does not trigger actions. Drag from right-side outputs to left-side inputs.

topics.title: Follow-Along: Timed Sun
topics.body: Goal: After level starts, gain 25 Sun every 5 seconds. Method 1: Events page → Add Rule Template → "Gain Sun Every 5s". The template will place pre-wired nodes automatically. Method 2: Manual setup. 1. Right-click to add "Level Officially Starts", "Timer Switch", and "Add Sun". 2. Connect Level Start "Trigger" to Timer Switch "Trigger". 3. Connect Timer Switch "Periodic Event" to Add Sun "Trigger". 4. Select Timer Switch, click "Enter Input Value", set interval to 5. 5. Select Add Sun, set Sun amount to 25. 6. Click "Verify Connections", ensure no errors, then save and test.

topics.title: How to Use the Toolbar
topics.body: The top bar contains the Event Rule Tools. It helps you build, edit, and check rules; it does not add effects to the level on its own. Common Actions: Add Rule Template: Inserts pre-wired rule snippets into the canvas. Node Description: Select a node to view its function, port specs, and examples. Enter Input Value: Directly enter unconnected inputs (delay seconds, sun count, etc.). Verify Connections: Checks for missing nodes, type mismatches, and infinite loops. Undo / Redo: Revert mistakes or reapply edits.

topics.title: Saving, Testing & Debugging
topics.body: Three types of saving: Page "Save Changes": Submits local edits on that page (cards, spawns, etc.). "Save Node Draft": Backs up the event graph for node editing recovery. Bottom "Save & Generate Level": Exports the complete level including event graph and all page settings. Testing Checklist: Can you pick cards, plant, and fight zombies? Do waves advance? Do win/loss triggers work? Do events fire at the right time? Do one-time rewards repeat? When delayed target plants die, does logic handle it cleanly? Exit and re-enter once to ensure counters reset.

topics.title: What's New in This Update
topics.body: New Capabilities: 1. Insert templates directly ("Wave 5 Tip", "5s Timed Sun", "Pick 1 of 3 Rewards") to skip repetitive node wiring. 2. Use Phase nodes to organize combat and reward flows; use "Run Once" to avoid duplicate rewards. 3. Name targets on the lawn (e.g. "Boss") to reference them elsewhere; listen for fusions, boss HP thresholds, or check plant layers. 4. Use dedicated Reward Selection nodes for 3-choice menus, preventing wire errors. 5. Undo/Redo, Input Value Entry, Node Descriptions, and Connection Checking make debugging much easier.

topics.title: Strings, Lists & Objects
topics.body:
Level Variables now include "+ String" and "+ List". Strings support read/write and conversion. Lists support editing initial values for ints, floats, booleans, strings, plant types, zombie types, and objects. Up to 512 items per list (8 per page, 0-indexed).

Use matching list nodes for Append, Insert, Replace, Get, and Find. Find returns first index and contains bool (-1 if not found). Deletion shifts elements left; cloning creates independent elements.

Object Binding gives lawn entities queryable names. Strings match the bound name; objects are acquired upon entity creation. If target entity dies or is dug up, subsequent calls evaluate to invalid targets.

topics.title: Combat Rule Limitations
topics.body:
Mode Settings now includes "Zombie In-House Defeat" (enabled by default; older levels retain default rules). Disabling lets events handle win/loss conditions; other defeat conditions (e.g. protect target) remain active.

Card Advanced Mode → Full Stats: Customize HP, damage, intervals, armor, etc. (applies only to current level; must save level).

Zombie spawn & movement supports fractional columns (e.g. 2.5 is between columns 3 and 4). If left blank, defaults to integer lanes.

Wait Condition and Loop Until Condition re-evaluate periodically (default 0.1s); loops do not freeze frames and terminate cleanly on phase change or level exit.

nodes.purpose: Executes initialization rules when the lawn board is ready.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger output to initialization actions; pre-placed plants are already placed.
nodes.example: Board Start → Display Text to show a welcome message.
nodes.warning: Triggers before the game officially starts. To time from active combat, use 'On Game Start'.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules after the game officially starts.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger output to timers, prompts, or initial rewards.
nodes.example: Game Start → Periodic Timer → Gain Sun.
nodes.warning: Also triggers when skipping the intro. The timer's first action occurs after one interval.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules whenever the wave increases, providing the current wave number.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger output to actions or branches, and wave data to Integer Compare.
nodes.example: Wave → Value A of Integer Compare (Value B = 5); Equal → Branch Condition; True → Display Text.
nodes.warning: Triggers on every wave; does not automatically filter for a specific wave.

nodes.purpose: Reads clicked grid tile, held item, and mouse button (left/right).
nodes.usage: Execution output starts rules; row/column outputs connect to spawn or query nodes.
nodes.example: Click → Branch; 'Is Left Click' → Condition; True → Display Prompt.
nodes.warning: Can trigger on both left and right clicks. Rows and columns are 0-indexed.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when a specified key is pressed.
nodes.usage: Assign a key in the node, then connect the trigger output.
nodes.example: Select Key → Display Text for in-level interactive prompts.
nodes.warning: Will not trigger if no key is assigned. Avoid conflicting with existing game hotkeys.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when a plant is planted, providing that plant.
nodes.usage: Trigger output starts actions; plant output reads attributes or modifies that target.
nodes.example: Event Trigger → Gain Sun (Amount = 25); filter types with Plant Split and Type Compare.
nodes.warning: Does not trigger for pre-placed plants at the start of the level.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when the player clicks a plant, providing that plant.
nodes.usage: Trigger output starts actions; plant output reads attributes or modifies that target.
nodes.example: Event Trigger → Gain Sun (Amount = 25); filter types with Plant Split and Type Compare.
nodes.warning: Different from mouse click events on empty lawn tiles.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when a plant's health reaches zero, providing that plant.
nodes.usage: Trigger output starts actions; plant output reads attributes or modifies that target.
nodes.example: Event Trigger → Gain Sun (Amount = 25); filter types with Plant Split and Type Compare.
nodes.warning: Does not cover all removal causes like fusions or manual shoveling.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when a plant finishes its death sequence, providing that plant.
nodes.usage: Trigger output starts actions; plant output reads attributes or modifies that target.
nodes.example: Event Trigger → Gain Sun (Amount = 25); filter types with Plant Split and Type Compare.
nodes.warning: Object may be destroyed shortly after; verify existence after waiting. Death cause output is an integer.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when plant fusion completes, providing the resulting plant.
nodes.usage: Trigger output starts actions; plant output reads attributes or modifies that target.
nodes.example: Event Trigger → Gain Sun (Amount = 25); filter types with Plant Split and Type Compare.
nodes.warning: Only listens to fusion events; regular planting will not trigger this.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when a zombie spawns, providing that zombie.
nodes.usage: Trigger output connects to actions; zombie output connects to split attributes or target processing.
nodes.example: Event → Display Text; Zombie Split → Type Compare → Branch to filter specific types.
nodes.warning: Triggers for both normal spawns and hypnotized spawns; filter targets as needed.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when a zombie dies, providing that zombie.
nodes.usage: Trigger output connects to actions; zombie output connects to split attributes or target processing.
nodes.example: Event → Display Text; Zombie Split → Type Compare → Branch to filter specific types.
nodes.warning: Target may be destroyed shortly after; actions after a delay should not assume target is alive.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules once when all enemies from a normal wave are cleared.
nodes.usage: Recorded per wave; trigger output grants rewards or switches stages; wave output gives the cleared wave.
nodes.example: Clearing Wave 1 enemies during Wave 2 still outputs Wave 1; Wave 2 enemies don't need to be cleared together.
nodes.warning: Spawned/summoned enemies belong to current wave; death/exit/hypnosis unblocks. Max once per wave. Depends on normal spawn completion; special spawn modes might not trigger; final victory may end combat first.

nodes.purpose: Triggers when specified zombie's base HP reaches a threshold.
nodes.usage: Zombie input connects to boss object; HP ratio 0.5 represents half health.
nodes.example: Create Boss → Bind Zombie; Get Bound Zombie → HP Below Threshold Event → Change Stage.
nodes.warning: Does not count armor. Monitoring the same target only triggers once; switching targets resets check; dead targets do not trigger.

nodes.purpose: Executes rules when entering a specified gameplay stage.
nodes.usage: Enter stage name in node, matching the name used in Change Stage.
nodes.example: Change Stage to 'Reward'; Enter Stage 'Reward' → Show Reward Selection.
nodes.warning: Initial stage is empty; consecutively switching to the same stage will not trigger repeatedly; names must match exactly.

nodes.purpose: Switches current level event graph to specified gameplay stage.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger input and enter stage name; completion output continues follow-up actions.
nodes.example: Boss Half HP → Change Stage, name 'Phase 2'.
nodes.warning: Cancels waits and timers from the previous stage; stage name does not automatically change zombie spawns or pause the game.

nodes.purpose: Reads current gameplay stage name.
nodes.usage: Connect text output to text inputs requiring stage name.
nodes.example: Get Current Stage → Text input of Display Text; trigger with key press.
nodes.warning: This is a query node without execution trigger; will not switch stages by itself.

nodes.purpose: Ensures an action or reward executes only the first time a signal is received.
nodes.usage: First trigger output connects to one-time action; trigger again with Reset=true to re-enable.
nodes.example: Repeated Event → Do Once → Gain Sun.
nodes.warning: Calling with Reset=true only resets state without executing action; must be triggered again afterward.

nodes.purpose: Assigns a custom name to a plant on the lawn for easy lookup elsewhere.
nodes.usage: Input plant object, enter name, and connect trigger signal.
nodes.example: Create Plant Success → Bind Plant, name 'Target'; connect object output to Bind Plant.
nodes.warning: Binding same name replaces previous target; valid only within current match's event graph.

nodes.purpose: Finds previously bound plant by name.
nodes.usage: Enter exact name used in Bind Plant; use Object and Exists outputs.
nodes.example: Get Bound Plant 'Exists' → Branch Condition; True branch operates on Object output.
nodes.warning: Returns null if not found or destroyed; always check 'Exists' first.

nodes.purpose: Assigns a custom name to a zombie on the lawn for easy lookup elsewhere.
nodes.usage: Input zombie object, enter name, and connect trigger signal.
nodes.example: Create Zombie Success → Bind Zombie, name 'Boss'; connect object output to Bind Zombie.
nodes.warning: Binding same name replaces previous target; valid only within current match's event graph.

nodes.purpose: Finds previously bound zombie by name.
nodes.usage: Enter exact name used in Bind Zombie; use Object and Exists outputs.
nodes.example: Get Bound Zombie 'Exists' → Branch Condition; True branch operates on Object output.
nodes.warning: Returns null if not found or destroyed; always check 'Exists' first.

nodes.purpose: Spawns a plant on a specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Provide plant type, row, and column; connect trigger; Success output connects to follow-up actions.
nodes.example: Game Start → Set Plant: Row 0, Col 0, Peashooter; Failure output connects to Display Text.
nodes.warning: Non-forced by default; water, roof, carrier, or existing plants may cause failure; rows and cols are 0-indexed.

nodes.purpose: Spawns a specified zombie type at a given location.
nodes.usage: Set row, col, zombie type, and hypnotized; use spawned zombie object after triggering.
nodes.example: Key Press → Create Zombie; Success output passes object to Bind Zombie.
nodes.warning: Data outputs do not spawn entities on their own; must execute the trigger; verify spawn position.

nodes.purpose: Moves an existing plant to a specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Connect lawn plant object and target coordinates, then connect trigger.
nodes.example: Create Plant → Move Plant to shift target column to another tile.
nodes.warning: Plant Type cannot substitute for Object; out-of-bounds, occupied, or invalid targets may fail; handle failure branch.

nodes.purpose: Moves an existing zombie to a specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Connect lawn zombie object and target coordinates, then connect trigger.
nodes.example: Create Zombie → Move Zombie to shift target column to another tile.
nodes.warning: Zombie Type cannot substitute for Object; out-of-bounds, occupied, or invalid targets may fail; handle failure branch.

nodes.purpose: Spawns a collectible plant card on the lawn.
nodes.usage: Specify plant type and spawn coordinates, then connect trigger.
nodes.example: Zombie Dies → Create Plant Card, select dropped plant type.
nodes.warning: Spawns card on lawn, does not add directly to seed bank; use 'Add Plant Card' for seed bank.

nodes.purpose: Adds a plant card to player's seed bank.
nodes.usage: Choose plant type; toggle default data off to customize cost and cooldown.
nodes.example: Reward Clicked → Add Plant Card, select Peashooter.
nodes.warning: May fail if seed bank is full; Planted trigger output tracks the plant placed from this card.

nodes.purpose: Removes plant cards of a specified type from seed bank.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger and provide plant type.
nodes.example: Enter Stage → Remove Plant Card from seed bank, then add new cards.
nodes.warning: Only removes cards from seed bank; does not remove plants already planted on lawn.

nodes.purpose: Restores health to specified plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object, enter heal amount, and connect trigger.
nodes.example: Plant Event Output → Object; Trigger Event → Heal Plant, enter desired amount.
nodes.warning: Verify target validity; healing and shields do not modify maximum health.

nodes.purpose: Inflicts damage on specified plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object, enter damage amount, and connect trigger.
nodes.example: Plant Event Output → Object; Trigger Event → Damage Plant, enter desired amount.
nodes.warning: Verify target validity; does not bypass invulnerability unless specified.

nodes.purpose: Inflicts damage on specified zombie.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie object, enter damage amount, and connect trigger.
nodes.example: Zombie Event Output → Object; Trigger Event → Damage Zombie, enter desired amount.
nodes.warning: Verify target validity; damage respects zombie armor rules.

nodes.purpose: Adds a protective shield to specified plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object, enter shield amount, and connect trigger.
nodes.example: Plant Event Output → Object; Trigger Event → Give Shield, enter desired amount.
nodes.warning: Verify target validity; shields absorb damage before plant health.

nodes.purpose: Directly removes specified plant and executes death handling.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object and trigger signal.
nodes.example: Click Plant → Condition Branch → Kill Plant, passing clicked plant object.
nodes.warning: Unlike dealing damage, may bypass HP reduction events; avoid connecting to all planting events.

nodes.purpose: Hypnotizes specified zombie to fight for the player.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie object and trigger signal.
nodes.example: Zombie Spawned → Set Zombie Mind Controlled, passing spawned zombie object.
nodes.warning: Requires a specific zombie object, not a zombie type; ensure target is valid.

nodes.purpose: Modifies attack bonus multiplier of specified plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object and trigger; set desired multiplier in float input.
nodes.example: Create Plant Success → Modify Plant Attack; pass object and observe values.
nodes.warning: Input is a bonus multiplier (default 1.0), not a flat stat override; setting repeatedly does not compound.

nodes.purpose: Modifies health bonus multiplier of specified plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object and trigger; set desired multiplier in float input.
nodes.example: Create Plant Success → Modify Plant Health; pass object and observe values.
nodes.warning: Input is a bonus multiplier (default 1.0), not a flat stat override; setting repeatedly does not compound.

nodes.purpose: Modifies health multiplier of specified zombie.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie object and trigger; set desired multiplier in float input.
nodes.example: Create Zombie Success → Modify Zombie Health; pass object and observe values.
nodes.warning: Input is a multiplier (default 1.0), not a flat stat override; setting repeatedly does not compound.

nodes.purpose: Reads row, column, and plant type from a specific plant.
nodes.usage: Input plant object; connect coordinate or type outputs to query/compare nodes.
nodes.example: Plant Event → Plant Split → Plant Type Compare → Condition Branch.
nodes.warning: Does not trigger actions on its own; if object is null, default coordinates should not be treated as actual position.

nodes.purpose: Reads row, column, and zombie type from a specific zombie.
nodes.usage: Input zombie object; connect coordinate or type outputs to query/compare nodes.
nodes.example: Zombie Event → Zombie Split → Zombie Type Compare → Condition Branch.
nodes.warning: Does not trigger actions on its own; if object is null, default coordinates should not be treated as actual position.

nodes.purpose: Retrieves all registered plants in a specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col; connect list output to For Each Plant.
nodes.example: Mouse Row/Col → Get Plants in Cell → For Each Plant; Mouse Click triggers loop.
nodes.warning: Includes all layers (Lily Pad, Flower Pot, Flying, Shell), not just main plant.

nodes.purpose: Queries plants on a specific layer in a grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col; choose layer: Main, Flower Pot, Lily Pad, Pumpkin, or Flying.
nodes.example: Mouse Row/Col → Get Plants on Layer (Main) → For Each Plant.
nodes.warning: Position layer is not combat class; returns empty list if out of bounds or empty.

nodes.purpose: Retrieves list of all registered plants on the lawn.
nodes.usage: Connect list output to For Each Plant; start loop from another event.
nodes.example: Level Start → For Each Plant; connect list from GetAllPlants.
nodes.warning: Connecting list alone does not execute loop; targets may die during subsequent actions.

nodes.purpose: Finds zombie closest to specified coordinates.
nodes.usage: Provide coordinates; connect object output to damage, hypnotize, or split nodes.
nodes.example: Key Press → Damage Zombie; connect nearest zombie output to target.
nodes.warning: Returns null if no valid targets on lawn; query itself does not inflict damage.

nodes.purpose: Reads most recent mouse or entity position recorded in execution chain.
nodes.usage: Enable retain trigger data; check Has Position before using row/column outputs. Coordinates persist after delays.
nodes.example: Click Lawn → Wait 1s → Spawn Plant at original clicked tile using row/column outputs.
nodes.warning: Coordinates remain readable after entity dies, but entity may no longer exist; returns false and (0,0) if no position recorded.

nodes.purpose: Processes each plant in a list sequentially.
nodes.usage: Connect list to input and event to trigger; loop body connects to actions using current item.
nodes.example: Get All Plants → For Each Plant; loop body performs action on each plant.
nodes.warning: Executes synchronously in the same frame; does not wait for Wait nodes inside loop body.

nodes.purpose: Processes each plant type in a list sequentially.
nodes.usage: Connect list to input and event to trigger; loop body connects to actions using current item.
nodes.example: Get Plant Type List → For Each Plant Type; loop body performs action for each type.
nodes.warning: Executes synchronously in the same frame; does not wait for Wait nodes inside loop body.

nodes.purpose: Provides a constant plant type.
nodes.usage: Select plant type in node; connect output to spawn or type comparison nodes.
nodes.example: Plant Type → Set Plant Type input; Game Start triggers spawn.
nodes.warning: Type is not an active entity on lawn; does not require trigger signal.

nodes.purpose: Provides a constant zombie type.
nodes.usage: Select zombie type in node; connect output to spawn or type comparison nodes.
nodes.example: Zombie Type → Create Zombie Type input; Game Start triggers spawn.
nodes.warning: Type is not an active entity on lawn; does not require trigger signal.

nodes.purpose: Checks if two plant types are identical.
nodes.usage: Connect two plant types to inputs; connect comparison result to branch condition.
nodes.example: Plant Split Type vs Constant Plant Type; Event triggers branch.
nodes.warning: Outputs a boolean value only; does not execute True branch on its own.

nodes.purpose: Checks if two zombie types are identical.
nodes.usage: Connect two zombie types to inputs; connect comparison result to branch condition.
nodes.example: Zombie Split Type vs Constant Zombie Type; Event triggers branch.
nodes.warning: Outputs a boolean value only; does not execute True branch on its own.

nodes.purpose: Wraps a single plant type into a list.
nodes.usage: Connect plant type to input; use list output for merging, random selection, or iteration.
nodes.example: Plant Type → Single Plant Type List → Merge Plant Type Lists.
nodes.warning: Produces a list of plant types, not active plant entities on the lawn.

nodes.purpose: Configures multiple plant types within a single node.
nodes.usage: Edit list within node; connect output to random selector or iteration loop.
nodes.example: Multi Plant Type List → Get Random Plant Type → Add Plant Card.
nodes.warning: If list is empty, subsequent random selection will not return a valid type.

nodes.purpose: Combines two plant type lists into one.
nodes.usage: Connect two lists to inputs; use merged result list or length output.
nodes.example: Two Single Plant Type Lists → Merge → Get Random Plant Type.
nodes.warning: Merging does not execute actions automatically; check for duplicate types if needed.

nodes.purpose: Saves and modifies a plant type list within the current match.
nodes.usage: Send list to storage node; select action (Set, Add, Remove) and trigger.
nodes.example: Set reward pool at start; remove chosen type after reward selection, then read remaining list.
nodes.warning: Unlike primitive variables, runtime modifications do not write back to initial editor lists.

nodes.purpose: Draws a random plant type from an input list.
nodes.usage: Provide non-empty type list; connect output to card or plant spawn type input.
nodes.example: Multi Plant Type List → Get Random Plant Type → Create Plant Card; trigger spawn on event.
nodes.warning: Draws randomly on read; multiple reads may return different types; avoid empty lists.

nodes.purpose: Removes a specified plant type from a plant type list.
nodes.usage: Connect source list and target type; use result list and success output.
nodes.example: Reward Pool List + Selected Type → Remove Plant Type → Follow-up list processing.
nodes.warning: Must use result list output; does not remove plants on lawn or cards in seed bank.

nodes.purpose: Displays a prompt message on the game screen.
nodes.usage: Enter text and duration (seconds); connect execution trigger.
nodes.example: Wave 5 True Branch → Show Text: 'The Boss has arrived!'.
nodes.warning: Connecting text alone does not display it; duration is specified in seconds.

nodes.purpose: Plays an existing game sound effect.
nodes.usage: Select or enter valid SFX ID; connect execution trigger.
nodes.example: Reward Option Clicked → Play Sound.
nodes.warning: Sound IDs correspond to game assets, not local file paths; invalid IDs produce no sound.

nodes.purpose: Switches the animation of a specified zombie.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie object; enter valid animation state name on that entity.
nodes.example: Create Zombie Success → Play Zombie Animation: 'walk'.
nodes.warning: Animation names must match entity assets; visual only, does not deal attack damage.

nodes.purpose: Grants a specified amount of Sun to the player.
nodes.usage: Enter integer amount; connect execution trigger.
nodes.example: Reward Option Clicked → Gain Sun (Amount = 50).
nodes.warning: Amount is an integer; triggers repeatedly if called multiple times; precede with 'Do Once' for one-time rewards.

nodes.purpose: Grants a specified amount of Coins to the player.
nodes.usage: Enter integer amount; connect execution trigger.
nodes.example: Reward Option Clicked → Gain Coins (Amount = 50).
nodes.warning: Amount is an integer; triggers repeatedly if called multiple times; precede with 'Do Once' for one-time rewards.

nodes.purpose: Attempts to deduct a specified amount of Sun from the player.
nodes.usage: Enter cost; Success output connects to purchased effect, Failure output connects to insufficient sun prompt.
nodes.example: Interact Event → Use Sun; Success grants reward, Failure shows insufficient warning.
nodes.warning: Do not connect rewards parallel to this node, otherwise reward may be granted even if deduction fails.

nodes.purpose: Attempts to deduct a specified amount of Coins from the player.
nodes.usage: Enter cost; Success output connects to purchased effect, Failure output connects to insufficient coins prompt.
nodes.example: Interact Event → Use Coins; Success grants reward, Failure shows insufficient warning.
nodes.warning: Do not connect rewards parallel to this node, otherwise reward may be granted even if deduction fails.

nodes.purpose: Reads player's current Sun count.
nodes.usage: Connect integer output to comparison or arithmetic nodes.
nodes.example: Current Sun Compare (≥ 100) → Branch Condition; interact event triggers branch.
nodes.warning: Query only; does not add or deduct Sun; use 'Use Sun' for transactions.

nodes.purpose: Grants a specified Odyssey Modifier to the match.
nodes.usage: Select modifier category and entry in node; connect trigger to apply.
nodes.example: Reward Choice → Gain Odyssey Modifier, select desired buff.
nodes.warning: Legacy node kept for backwards compatibility; prefer 'Gain Travel Entry' in newer rules.

nodes.purpose: Grants a specified Odyssey Modifier to the match.
nodes.usage: Select modifier category and entry in node; connect trigger to apply.
nodes.example: Reward Choice → Gain Odyssey Modifier, select desired buff.
nodes.warning: Legacy node kept for backwards compatibility; prefer 'Gain Travel Entry' in newer rules.

nodes.purpose: Manually triggers a Game Over defeat for this match.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger to defeat condition branch; enter defeat reason.
nodes.example: Defense Objective Destroyed → Game Over (Reason: 'Target Destroyed').
nodes.warning: Do not connect to unconditional start events; defeat sequence terminates current combat.

nodes.purpose: Manually triggers victory settlement for this match.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger to mission completed branch.
nodes.example: Target Count Reached → Branch True → Game Win.
nodes.warning: Comparison result alone will not finish level; requires execution trigger signal.

nodes.purpose: Spawns a tombstone at the specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col along with optional parameters; connect trigger.
nodes.example: Target Wave → Create Grave at specified tile.
nodes.warning: Rows and cols are 0-indexed; obstacles alter plantable space.

nodes.purpose: Spawns white smoke visual particle effect at specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col along with optional parameters; connect trigger.
nodes.example: Target Wave → Create Particle Effect at specified tile.
nodes.warning: Rows and cols are 0-indexed; smoke is visual only and does not affect gameplay mechanics.

nodes.purpose: Spawns a ladder obstacle at the specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col along with optional parameters; connect trigger.
nodes.example: Target Wave → Create Ladder at specified tile.
nodes.warning: Rows and cols are 0-indexed; obstacles alter plantable space.

nodes.purpose: Spawns a crater obstacle at the specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col along with optional parameters; connect trigger.
nodes.example: Target Wave → Create Crater at specified tile.
nodes.warning: Rows and cols are 0-indexed; craters temporarily prevent planting.

nodes.purpose: Spawns an ice block obstacle at the specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Enter row and col along with optional parameters; connect trigger.
nodes.example: Target Wave → Create Ice Block at specified tile.
nodes.warning: Rows and cols are 0-indexed; encased plants must be configured separately.

nodes.purpose: Directly triggers Ice-shroom freeze effect across the entire lawn.
nodes.usage: Configure duration/damage parameters; triggers screen-wide freeze.
nodes.example: Skill Key Event → Ice-shroom Freeze Effect.
nodes.warning: Direct effect that does not plant an entity; test freeze duration in sandbox first.

nodes.purpose: Directly triggers Jalapeño fire effect along a specified lane.
nodes.usage: Configure target row and damage parameters; triggers lane-wide burn.
nodes.example: Skill Key Event → Jalapeño Fire Effect.
nodes.warning: Direct effect that does not plant an entity; verifies target row before dealing damage.

nodes.purpose: Directly triggers Doom-shroom explosion effect around specified tile.
nodes.usage: Configure row, column, and damage parameters; triggers 3x3 blast.
nodes.example: Skill Key Event → Doom-shroom Explosion Effect.
nodes.warning: Direct effect that does not plant an entity; check crater creation settings.

nodes.purpose: Directly triggers Cherry Bomb explosion effect around specified tile.
nodes.usage: Configure row, column, and damage parameters; triggers 3x3 blast.
nodes.example: Skill Key Event → Cherry Bomb Explosion Effect.
nodes.warning: Direct effect that does not plant an entity; deals standard explosive damage.

nodes.purpose: Directly triggers Jack-in-the-Box zombie explosion effect at specified location.
nodes.usage: Configure row, column, and damage parameters; triggers explosion.
nodes.example: Skill Key Event → Jack-in-the-Box Explosion Effect.
nodes.warning: Direct effect that does not spawn a zombie entity; damages surrounding plants.

nodes.purpose: Adds a selectable card option to a reward choice menu.
nodes.usage: Enter title, description, and display content; chain list output to next option or menu; Click output triggers reward.
nodes.example: Chain three options into Show Menu; Click outputs connect to Sun, Coins, and Cards respectively.
nodes.warning: Options are constructed when menu reads the list; use with 'Typed Choice Menu'.

nodes.purpose: Adds a selectable card option to a reward choice menu.
nodes.usage: Enter title, description, and display content; chain list output to next option or menu; Click output triggers reward.
nodes.example: Chain three options into Show Menu; Click outputs connect to Sun, Coins, and Cards respectively.
nodes.warning: Legacy GameObject option port; pair with legacy Multi-Choice Menu.

nodes.purpose: Opens a multi-choice menu letting player choose a reward.
nodes.usage: Connect option list input; trigger with event signal; configure display count, reroll, and cancel options.
nodes.example: Wave Cleared → Show Choice Menu; connect 3 chained options, set window count to 3.
nodes.warning: Window count limited to 1-5; pauses game while active; resumes on select or cancel.

nodes.purpose: Opens a multi-choice menu letting player choose a reward.
nodes.usage: Connect option list input; trigger with event signal; configure display count, reroll, and cancel options.
nodes.example: Wave Cleared → Show Choice Menu; connect 3 chained options, set window count to 3.
nodes.warning: Window count limited to 1-5; pauses game while active; resumes on select or cancel.

nodes.purpose: Merges two reward option lists into a single list.
nodes.usage: Connect lists A and B to inputs; use output for menu or further merging.
nodes.example: Two independent option lists → Merge Options → Show Choice Menu.
nodes.warning: Do not mix typed options with legacy GameObject options; merging does not open the menu by itself.

nodes.purpose: Merges two reward option lists into a single list.
nodes.usage: Connect lists A and B to inputs; use output for menu or further merging.
nodes.example: Two independent option lists → Merge Options → Show Choice Menu.
nodes.warning: Do not mix typed options with legacy GameObject options; merging does not open the menu by itself.

nodes.purpose: Creates an information card in seed bank that responds to player clicks.
nodes.usage: Configure display contents; connect trigger; Click output connects to interactive actions.
nodes.example: Game Start → Create Info Card; Card Clicked → Show Mission Objectives.
nodes.warning: Used for informational prompts, not plantable cards; click callback expires when event graph terminates.

nodes.purpose: Directs execution flow along True or False path based on condition.
nodes.usage: Connect execution trigger; connect comparison result to Condition; True and False outputs connect to follow-up actions.
nodes.example: Current Sun ≥ 100 → Condition; Key Press triggers Branch; True and False display different text.
nodes.warning: Defaults to False if Condition is unconnected. 'False (Stop)' still executes False branch.

nodes.purpose: Delays execution by specified number of seconds before continuing.
nodes.usage: Enter delay duration (seconds); connect execution trigger; output connects to follow-up actions.
nodes.example: Game Start → Wait (5s) → Display Text.
nodes.warning: Each trigger instance waits independently; timer pauses during game pause; exiting match cancels waiting.

nodes.purpose: Repeats execution of loop body synchronously within the same frame.
nodes.usage: Specify loop count; Loop Body connects to actions; Index output is 0-indexed.
nodes.example: Loop 3 Times → Create Plant; Index connects to Column (0, 1, 2).
nodes.warning: Executes synchronously in one frame, does not wait for asynchronous tasks; excessive counts trigger safety limit.

nodes.purpose: Toggles a periodic repeating timer on and off.
nodes.usage: First trigger turns on, second trigger turns off; Cycle Event output triggers periodic action.
nodes.example: Game Start → Toggle Cycle (Interval = 5s) → Gain 25 Sun.
nodes.warning: First cycle executes after one full interval; minimum interval is 0.1s; timer pauses during game pause.

nodes.purpose: Randomly triggers a specified number of downstream actions from candidates.
nodes.usage: Connect candidate actions to output; configure pick count and allow repeats.
nodes.example: Key Press → Random Trigger → Three different prompt nodes.
nodes.warning: Without repeats, pick count cannot exceed number of candidates; selects execution branches, not random numbers.

nodes.purpose: Tracks trigger counts for objective progress and condition checks.
nodes.usage: Connect event to trigger; Count output connects to Integer Compare; configure initial value and reset input.
nodes.example: Zombie Dies → Counter; Count == 10 → Branch → Mission Complete.
nodes.warning: First execution loads initial value before incrementing; Reset sets count to 0, not initial value.

nodes.purpose: Toggles boolean state between ON and OFF on each trigger.
nodes.usage: Trigger input flips state; State output provides boolean; State Changed output triggers follow-up actions.
nodes.example: Key Press → Toggle; State connects to Branch Condition, State Changed triggers branch.
nodes.warning: Reading state does not toggle it; runtime state resets each match.

nodes.purpose: Outputs True only during synchronous execution of downstream nodes.
nodes.usage: Trigger pulse, passing boolean output to synchronous downstream conditions.
nodes.example: Event → Pulse; Execution connects to Branch, Boolean output connects to Condition.
nodes.warning: Resets immediately after synchronous execution in the same frame, not on next frame.

nodes.purpose: Inverts a boolean value (NOT logic).
nodes.usage: Connect boolean input; connect inverted output to condition branch.
nodes.example: True input outputs False; use separate event signal to trigger branch.
nodes.warning: Logical operation only; does not trigger actions on its own.

nodes.purpose: Checks if both boolean conditions are true (AND logic).
nodes.usage: Connect two boolean inputs; connect result output to condition branch.
nodes.example: Has Enough Sun AND Target Wave Reached → Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Logical operation only; does not trigger actions on its own.

nodes.purpose: Checks if at least one boolean condition is true (OR logic).
nodes.usage: Connect two boolean inputs; connect result output to condition branch.
nodes.example: Boss Defeated OR Target Count Reached → Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Logical operation only; does not trigger actions on its own.

nodes.purpose: Compares two integers and outputs boolean comparison results.
nodes.usage: Connect two integer values; connect desired comparison output (Equal, Greater, etc.) to condition branch.
nodes.example: Compare Wave and 5; connect Equal output to Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Types must match; inputs require integer values.

nodes.purpose: Compares two floating-point numbers and outputs boolean comparison results.
nodes.usage: Connect two float values; connect desired comparison output (Equal, Greater, etc.) to condition branch.
nodes.example: Compare HP Ratio and 0.5; connect Less Than output to Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Types must match; inputs require float values.

nodes.purpose: Compares two game objects to check if they refer to the exact same instance.
nodes.usage: Connect two object inputs; connect Equal output to condition branch.
nodes.example: Compare Held Item with Target Object; connect Equal to Condition.
nodes.warning: Compares instance references, not matching names or entity types.

nodes.purpose: Provides a constant integer to multiple nodes.
nodes.usage: Enter the value in the node, then connect the output to inputs of the same type.
nodes.example: Enter 25, connect to an action input requiring this value; use an event to trigger the action.
nodes.warning: Constants do not require a trigger. If only setting an unconnected input, you can also use 'Set Input Value' on the toolbar directly.

nodes.purpose: Provides a constant float to multiple nodes.
nodes.usage: Enter the value in the node, then connect the output to inputs of the same type.
nodes.example: Enter 0.5, connect to an action input requiring this value; use an event to trigger the action.
nodes.warning: Constants do not require a trigger. If only setting an unconnected input, you can also use 'Set Input Value' on the toolbar directly.

nodes.purpose: Provides a constant boolean to multiple nodes.
nodes.usage: Enter the value in the node, then connect the output to inputs of the same type.
nodes.example: Enter true, connect to an action input requiring this value; use an event to trigger the action.
nodes.warning: Constants do not require a trigger. If only setting an unconnected input, you can also use 'Set Input Value' on the toolbar directly.

nodes.purpose: Provides a constant string to multiple nodes.
nodes.usage: Enter the value in the node, then connect the output to inputs of the same type.
nodes.example: Enter 'Boss Incoming!', connect to an action input requiring this value; use an event to trigger the action.
nodes.warning: Constants do not require a trigger. If only setting an unconnected input, you can also use 'Set Input Value' on the toolbar directly.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the addition of two numbers.
nodes.usage: Connect two numbers of the same type; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 2 and 3 yield addition result 5; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the subtraction of two numbers.
nodes.usage: Connect two numbers of the same type; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 5 and 2 yield subtraction result 3; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the multiplication of two numbers.
nodes.usage: Connect two numbers of the same type; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 2 and 3 yield multiplication result 6; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the division of two numbers.
nodes.usage: Connect two numbers of the same type; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 6 and 2 yield division result 3; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the addition of two integers.
nodes.usage: Connect two integers; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 2 and 3 yield integer addition result 5; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the subtraction of two integers.
nodes.usage: Connect two integers; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 5 and 2 yield integer subtraction result 3; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the multiplication of two integers.
nodes.usage: Connect two integers; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 2 and 3 yield integer multiplication result 6; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the division of two integers.
nodes.usage: Connect two integers; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 7 and 2 yield integer division result 3; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Calculates the modulo (remainder) of two integers.
nodes.usage: Connect two integers; connect the result to an action, comparison, or variable setting input.
nodes.example: Inputs 7 and 2 yield integer modulo result 1; use an event to trigger actions reading the result.
nodes.warning: Do not mix integer and float ports. Avoid division or modulo by 0. Integer division truncates decimals.

nodes.purpose: Concatenates two text strings in order.
nodes.usage: Connect two strings to inputs; connect the output to Display Text.
nodes.example: Concatenate 'Current Reward: ' and 'Sun', then trigger display.
nodes.warning: Numbers must be converted to strings first. Concatenation does not automatically insert spaces or line breaks.

nodes.purpose: Picks a random integer within a range.
nodes.usage: Enter minimum and maximum values; connect output to reward amount or other numeric input.
nodes.example: Range set to 10 - 50 -> Sun amount gained; floats should be converted to integers as needed.
nodes.warning: May re-randomize every time it is read. If multiple actions need the same value, store it in a variable first. Range is inclusive of both bounds.

nodes.purpose: Picks a random float within a range.
nodes.usage: Enter minimum and maximum values; connect output to duration or other numeric input.
nodes.example: Range set to 1.5 - 5.0 -> Timer duration or multiplier.
nodes.warning: May re-randomize every time it is read. If multiple actions need the same value, store it in a variable first.

nodes.purpose: References a shared integer variable from the Level Variables panel.
nodes.usage: Drag in from the Level Variables panel; connect the variable port to the corresponding Get or Set node.
nodes.example: Variable Reference -> Get Integer -> Compare or Calculate.
nodes.warning: Dragging the same variable in multiple times still shares the same value. Normal copy shares original variable; template insertion copies an independent variable.

nodes.purpose: Reads the current value stored in an integer variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable input to the variable reference dragged from Level Variables panel; output provides the raw value.
nodes.example: Variable Reference -> Get Value -> Add / Compare -> Subsequent Action.
nodes.warning: Has no trigger port; only reads the current value. Reading does not automatically execute upstream set actions.

nodes.purpose: Stores a new value into a shared integer variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable reference, new value, and trigger; connect completion output to subsequent actions that depend on the new value.
nodes.example: Event -> Set Variable; Completed -> Display or check updated result.
nodes.warning: Connecting a new value without triggering will not write to the variable. Variable output can daisy-chain to other Set nodes, but action sequence still requires execution flow lines.

nodes.purpose: References a shared float variable from the Level Variables panel.
nodes.usage: Drag in from the Level Variables panel; connect the variable port to the corresponding Get or Set node.
nodes.example: Variable Reference -> Get Float -> Compare or Calculate.
nodes.warning: Dragging the same variable in multiple times still shares the same value. Normal copy shares original variable; template insertion copies an independent variable.

nodes.purpose: Reads the current value stored in a float variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable input to the variable reference dragged from Level Variables panel; output provides the raw value.
nodes.example: Variable Reference -> Get Value -> Add / Compare -> Subsequent Action.
nodes.warning: Has no trigger port; only reads the current value. Reading does not automatically execute upstream set actions.

nodes.purpose: Stores a new value into a shared float variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable reference, new value, and trigger; connect completion output to subsequent actions that depend on the new value.
nodes.example: Event -> Set Variable; Completed -> Display or check updated result.
nodes.warning: Connecting a new value without triggering will not write to the variable. Variable output can daisy-chain to other Set nodes, but action sequence still requires execution flow lines.

nodes.purpose: References a shared boolean variable from the Level Variables panel.
nodes.usage: Drag in from the Level Variables panel; connect the variable port to the corresponding Get or Set node.
nodes.example: Variable Reference -> Get Bool -> Compare or Branch.
nodes.warning: Dragging the same variable in multiple times still shares the same value. Normal copy shares original variable; template insertion copies an independent variable.

nodes.purpose: Reads the current value stored in a boolean variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable input to the variable reference dragged from Level Variables panel; output provides the raw boolean.
nodes.example: Variable Reference -> Get Value -> Branch Condition -> Subsequent Action.
nodes.warning: Has no trigger port; only reads the current value. Reading does not automatically execute upstream set actions.

nodes.purpose: Stores a new value into a shared boolean variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable reference, new value, and trigger; connect completion output to subsequent actions that depend on the new value.
nodes.example: Event -> Set Variable; Completed -> Display or check updated result.
nodes.warning: Connecting a new value without triggering will not write to the variable.

nodes.purpose: Converts an integer to a float type.
nodes.usage: Integer input, float output connects to ports requiring floats.
nodes.example: Integer 5 -> Int to Float -> Wait Duration.
nodes.warning: Value 5 becomes 5.0; it will not scale to 0.05.

nodes.purpose: Converts a float to an integer, truncating decimal digits.
nodes.usage: Float input, integer output connects to counters, Sun amount, etc.
nodes.example: 2.9 converts to 2, then passed to inputs requiring integers.
nodes.warning: Truncates towards zero, does not round. Negative numbers also truncate towards zero.

nodes.purpose: Converts a number to text for display.
nodes.usage: Input float; set number of decimal places to keep in the node.
nodes.example: Numeric Value -> Float to String -> Display Text port.
nodes.warning: Output is text and cannot be used in arithmetic calculations directly. Decimal places range from 0 to 6.

nodes.purpose: Base implementation of variable references, used internally by specific variable nodes.
nodes.usage: Create Int, Float, or Bool variables from the Level Variables panel; do not create this base node directly.
nodes.example: Use Integer Variable Reference -> Get Integer.
nodes.warning: Not present in the right-click create menu; not intended as an independent user node.

nodes.purpose: Reads the current text stored in a shared string variable.
nodes.usage: Connect variable input to a string variable reference; output provides the stored text.
nodes.example: String Variable Reference -> Get String -> Display Text content.
nodes.warning: Returns an empty string if unconnected. Reading does not execute write operations.

nodes.purpose: Modifies a shared string variable upon trigger.
nodes.usage: Connect variable reference, new text, and trigger input.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Set String; variable connected to 'Objective Text', new value set to 'Defend the Boss'.
nodes.warning: If object is null, type mismatches, or input is out of bounds, failure output/default value is used.

nodes.purpose: Performs add, subtract, multiply, divide, or modulo directly on a shared integer variable in one trigger.
nodes.usage: Connect variable reference and trigger; select operation in node dropdown.
nodes.example: Zombie Dies -> Int Variable Arithmetic; select 'Add', operand set to 1 to increment counter.
nodes.warning: Division by zero or overflow routes to failure output, leaving original value unchanged. Integer division truncates towards 0. Default operand is 1 if empty.

nodes.purpose: Performs add, subtract, multiply, divide, or modulo directly on a shared float variable in one trigger.
nodes.usage: Connect variable reference and trigger; select operation in node dropdown.
nodes.example: Zombie Dies -> Float Variable Arithmetic; select 'Add', operand set to 1.0 to increment counter.
nodes.warning: Division by zero or overflow routes to failure output, leaving original value unchanged. Default operand is 1.0 if empty.

nodes.purpose: Calculates power of a number.
nodes.usage: Connect base value and exponent; output provides power result.
nodes.example: Base 2, Exponent 3 -> Power result 8.
nodes.warning: For logarithmic operations use the Logarithm node. Unrepresentable results return 0 with Valid=False.

nodes.purpose: Calculates logarithm with a specified base for finite floats.
nodes.usage: Connect value and base; output provides logarithm result.
nodes.example: Value 8, Base 2 -> Logarithm result 3.
nodes.warning: Logarithm requires value and base > 0, base != 1. Unrepresentable results return 0 with Valid=False.

nodes.purpose: Evaluates 0 as False, and any other non-zero integer as True.
nodes.usage: Connect integer to input; output boolean connects to branch conditions.
nodes.example: Integer Count -> Int to Bool -> Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Negative numbers also evaluate to True.

nodes.purpose: Evaluates 0.0 as False, and other finite non-zero floats as True.
nodes.usage: Connect float to input; output boolean connects to branch conditions.
nodes.example: Float Value -> Float to Bool -> Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Float NaN and Infinity both evaluate to False. Negative numbers evaluate to True.

nodes.purpose: Converts an integer to readable text.
nodes.usage: Connect integer to input; string output connects to text display nodes.
nodes.example: Integer -> Int to String -> Set String.
nodes.warning: Numbers use fixed-point decimal format.

nodes.purpose: Parses a string into an integer, outputting the result and whether parsing succeeded.
nodes.usage: Connect string input; output provides integer value and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: String '25' -> String to Int -> Sun Amount; check Valid output first.
nodes.warning: Empty, invalid, or out-of-range strings return default 0 with Valid=False. For ASCII conversion use String to ASCII node.

nodes.purpose: Parses a string into a float, outputting the result and whether parsing succeeded.
nodes.usage: Connect string input; output provides float value and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: String '1.5' -> String to Float -> Timer Duration; check Valid output first.
nodes.warning: Empty or non-numeric strings return default 0.0 with Valid=False.

nodes.purpose: Converts a plant type enum to readable text.
nodes.usage: Connect plant type input; output string provides enum identifier name.
nodes.example: Plant Type -> Plant Type to String -> Set String.
nodes.warning: Outputs internal enum member name (e.g., 'Peashooter'), not localized display name.

nodes.purpose: Parses a string or enum name into a plant type, outputting the type and validity.
nodes.usage: Connect string to input; output provides Plant Type and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: String 'Peashooter' -> String to Plant Type -> Spawn Plant; check Valid output first.
nodes.warning: Blank, invalid names, or unrecognized IDs return default with Valid=False.

nodes.purpose: Converts a zombie type enum to readable text.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie type input; output string provides enum identifier name.
nodes.example: Zombie Type -> Zombie Type to String -> Set String.
nodes.warning: Outputs internal enum member name (e.g., 'Zombie'), not localized display name.

nodes.purpose: Parses a string or enum name into a zombie type, outputting the type and validity.
nodes.usage: Connect string to input; output provides Zombie Type and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: String 'Zombie' -> String to Zombie Type -> Spawn Zombie; check Valid output first.
nodes.warning: Blank, invalid names, or unrecognized IDs return default with Valid=False.

nodes.purpose: Reads the ASCII code of a character at the specified index in a string (0-indexed).
nodes.usage: Connect string and index; output provides integer ASCII code.
nodes.example: String 'A', Index 0 -> ASCII 65.
nodes.warning: Only accepts ASCII characters 0 - 127. Non-ASCII characters return Valid=False.

nodes.purpose: Converts an ASCII code (0 - 127) into a single-character string.
nodes.usage: Connect integer ASCII code; output provides single-character string.
nodes.example: ASCII 65 -> 'A'.
nodes.warning: Out-of-range values return empty string. Control characters may be invisible.

nodes.purpose: Appends an integer value to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create an integer list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append Int List; list connected to 'Reward Pool', value connected to constant or calculated int.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items. Type mismatch or out of bounds triggers failure output without modifying the list.

nodes.purpose: Inserts an integer value into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Create an integer list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port, index, value, and trigger.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Insert Int List; list connected to 'Reward Pool', index 0, value connected to int.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length (appends to end). Maximum 512 items. Type mismatch or out of bounds triggers failure without modifying the list.

nodes.purpose: Replaces an integer value at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create an integer list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port, index, value, and trigger.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Replace Int List; list connected to 'Reward Pool', index 0, new value.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. The index must already exist. Maximum 512 items. Type mismatch or out of bounds triggers failure without modifying the list.

nodes.purpose: Reads the value at the specified index in a shared integer list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides the integer value and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Reward Amounts' -> Get Int List Item (Index 0) -> Gain Sun.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. If type mismatches or index is out of bounds, Valid is False.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching value, and whether the list contains that value.
nodes.usage: Connect list and value to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Completed Quests' and value 1 -> Find Int List Value -> Contains port connects to Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found.

nodes.purpose: Appends a float value to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create a float list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append Float List; list connected to 'Speed Multipliers', value connected to float.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items. Type mismatch or out of bounds triggers failure without modifying the list.

nodes.purpose: Inserts a float value into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Create a float list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port, index, value, and trigger.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Insert Float List; list connected to 'Cooldowns', index 0, value connected to float.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length (appends to end). Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Replaces a float value at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create a float list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port, index, value, and trigger.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Replace Float List; list connected to 'Values', index 0, new value.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. The index must already exist. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Reads the value at the specified index in a shared float list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides float value and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Speeds' -> Get Float List Item (Index 0) -> Set Speed.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed; Valid is False if type mismatches or index is out of bounds.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching float value, and whether the list contains that value.
nodes.usage: Connect list and float value to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Factors' and value 1.5 -> Find Float List Value -> Contains port connects to Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found. Floats use exact equality comparison.

nodes.purpose: Appends a boolean value to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create a boolean list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append Bool List; list connected to 'Flags', value connected to bool.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Inserts a boolean value into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to insert.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Insert Bool List; list connected to 'Flags', index 0, value true.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Replaces a boolean value at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to replace.
nodes.example: Event -> Replace Bool List; list connected to 'Flags', index 0, value false.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Index must already exist. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Reads the boolean at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides boolean value and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Flags' -> Get Bool List Item (Index 0) -> Branch Condition.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Valid is False if type mismatches or index is out of bounds.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching boolean value, and whether the list contains that value.
nodes.usage: Connect list and boolean value to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Flags' and value true -> Find Bool List Value -> Contains port connects to Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found.

nodes.purpose: Appends a string value to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create a string list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append String List; list connected to 'Quest Names', value connected to string.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Inserts a string value into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to insert.
nodes.example: Event -> Insert String List; list connected to 'Dialogues', index 0, value string.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Replaces a string value at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to replace.
nodes.example: Event -> Replace String List; list connected to 'Dialogues', index 0, new value.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Index must already exist. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Reads the string at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides string value and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Dialogues' -> Get String List Item (Index 0) -> Display Text.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Valid is False if type mismatches or index is out of bounds.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching string value, and whether the list contains that value.
nodes.usage: Connect list and string value to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Completed Tasks' and value 'Boss' -> Find String List Value -> Contains connects to Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found. String comparison is case-sensitive.

nodes.purpose: Appends a plant type value to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create a plant type list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append Plant Type List; list connected to 'Seed Pool', value connected to plant type.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Inserts a plant type value into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to insert.
nodes.example: Event -> Insert Plant Type List; list connected to 'Seed Pool', index 0, value plant type.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Replaces a plant type value at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to replace.
nodes.example: Event -> Replace Plant Type List; list connected to 'Seed Pool', index 0, new value.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Index must already exist. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Reads the plant type at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides plant type and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Seed Pool' -> Get Plant Type List Item (Index 0) -> Add Seed Card.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Valid is False if type mismatches or index is out of bounds.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching plant type value, and whether the list contains that value.
nodes.usage: Connect list and plant type to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Banned Plants' and value Peashooter -> Find Plant Type List Value -> Contains connects to Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found.

nodes.purpose: Appends a zombie type value to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create a zombie type list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append Zombie Type List; list connected to 'Spawn Pool', value connected to zombie type.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Inserts a zombie type value into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to insert.
nodes.example: Event -> Insert Zombie Type List; list connected to 'Spawn Pool', index 0, value zombie type.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Replaces a zombie type value at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to replace.
nodes.example: Event -> Replace Zombie Type List; list connected to 'Spawn Pool', index 0, new value.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Index must already exist. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Reads the zombie type at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides zombie type and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Wave Zombies' -> Get Zombie Type List Item (Index 0) -> Spawn Zombie.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Valid is False if type mismatches or index is out of bounds.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching zombie type value, and whether the list contains that value.
nodes.usage: Connect list and zombie type to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Special Zombies' and value Gargantuar -> Find Zombie Type List Value -> Contains connects to Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found.

nodes.purpose: Appends an object reference to a shared list.
nodes.usage: Create an object list in Level Variables and drag to canvas; connect list port to this node and trigger to append.
nodes.example: On Game Start -> Append Object List; list connected to 'Object Pool', value connected to object reference.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Inserts an object reference into a shared list at the specified index.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to insert.
nodes.example: Event -> Insert Object List; list connected to 'Objects', index 0, value object reference.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Insert allows index equal to length. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Replaces an object reference at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list port, index, value, and trigger to replace.
nodes.example: Event -> Replace Object List; list connected to 'Objects', index 0, new object reference.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed. Index must already exist. Maximum 512 items.

nodes.purpose: Reads the object reference at the specified index in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and index inputs; output provides object reference and IsValid boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Spawned Markers' -> Get Object List Item (Index 0) -> Destroy Event Object.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed; Valid is False if type mismatches or index is out of bounds. Returns null if object was destroyed.

nodes.purpose: Outputs the first index of a matching object reference, and whether the list contains that object.
nodes.usage: Connect list and object to inputs; output provides index and Contains boolean.
nodes.example: List 'Tracked Objects' and object reference -> Find Object List Value -> Contains connects to Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns index -1 and Contains=False if not found.

nodes.purpose: Reads the current number of elements in a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list input; output provides integer length.
nodes.example: List -> List Length -> Integer Compare (Equal to 0) -> Branch.
nodes.warning: Returns 0 if unconnected or empty.

nodes.purpose: Removes the element at the specified index, shifting subsequent elements forward.
nodes.usage: Connect list, index, and trigger to remove item.
nodes.example: Claim Reward -> Remove List Item (Index 0); next element becomes index 0.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed; routes to failure output if index is out of bounds.

nodes.purpose: Replaces the target list's contents with the source list; both containers remain independent afterwards.
nodes.usage: Connect source list, target list, and trigger.
nodes.example: Phase Start -> Copy List: Default Reward Pool copied to Current Reward Pool.
nodes.warning: Element types must match. Copies container values; object elements still point to the same scene objects without cloning.

nodes.purpose: Clears all elements from a shared list.
nodes.usage: Connect list and trigger to clear.
nodes.example: New Round Starts -> Clear List 'Defeated Targets This Round'.
nodes.warning: All nodes referencing the same list immediately see an empty list.

nodes.purpose: Captures a snapshot of all currently alive zombies on the lawn board.
nodes.usage: Connect output to For Each Zombie list to process all alive zombies.
nodes.example: All Zombies -> For Each Zombie -> Set Zombie Status (Chill).
nodes.warning: Only enumerates zombies at the moment of reading; does not continuously track. Includes both enemy and charmed zombies; filter with Zombie Split if needed.

nodes.purpose: Outputs each alive zombie in the list sequentially, then triggers Completed when finished.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie list and trigger; 'Loop' output executes actions for each zombie; 'Completed' output triggers when done.
nodes.example: All Zombies -> Zombie List; Loop -> Modify Zombie Status; Completed -> Display Text.
nodes.warning: The input list is shallow-copied once; killing or spawning zombies during the loop will not alter the current set.

nodes.purpose: Sets the specified status, duration in seconds, or stacks on a zombie.
nodes.usage: Select status from dropdown. For Chill, Poison, Freeze, and Teleport, enter seconds. For Enraged/Ember, enter 0 to clear or positive to enable. For Garlic/Kelp/Freeze stacks, enter target stacks.
nodes.example: Select Chill, Value 5 -> Chills target zombie for 5 seconds upon trigger.
nodes.warning: Uses native game status logic, honoring immunities, reactions, and freeze rules. Value 0 removes status.

nodes.purpose: Reads remaining seconds, active flag, or stack count of a specified status on a zombie.
nodes.usage: Select status and connect zombie object input; output provides numeric value and IsActive boolean.
nodes.example: Select Freeze Stacks -> Float Compare (Greater Than or Equal to 50).
nodes.warning: Enraged/Ember returns 1 or 0; Chill/Poison/Freeze/Teleport returns remaining seconds; others return stack counts. Null object returns 0/false.

nodes.purpose: Applies a specified amount of curse to a plant, or clears it with value 0.
nodes.usage: Connect target plant and trigger; enter curse value.
nodes.example: Curse Value 50 -> Adds 50 curse to the target plant.
nodes.warning: Uses native game curse mechanics; curse grows over time and can be lethal. Positive values add curse; 0 clears curse.

nodes.purpose: Pauses plant actions following standard plant silence rules.
nodes.usage: Enter duration in seconds and Force flag; connect plant and trigger.
nodes.example: Duration 3 seconds, Force False -> Attempts to silence following map and plant resistances.
nodes.warning: Outputs Completed immediately upon successful application; outputs Failed if target is null, dead, immune, or duration is invalid. Force=True bypasses resistance checks.

nodes.purpose: Overrides the total attack speed multiplier for the plant; 1.0 is base attack speed.
nodes.usage: Connect plant, trigger, and multiplier value.
nodes.example: Multiplier 2.0 causes attack cooldown to decrease twice as fast as base speed.
nodes.warning: Allowed range: 0.01 to 100. Overrides current total bonus; subsequent buffs or Travel entries still stack. Specific attack animations and unique skills still obey their own rules.

nodes.purpose: Reads the current attack speed multiplier and base attack interval of a plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object; outputs speed multiplier and base interval.
nodes.example: Read multiplier, multiply by 1.2, then write to Set Plant Attack Speed.
nodes.warning: If object is null or invalid, routes to failure output / default values.

nodes.purpose: Sets the attribute countdown used for plant skills, growth, swallowing, etc.
nodes.usage: Remaining seconds modifies current countdown; empty is treated as 0 (completes next frame). Max seconds -1 retains current cycle; non-negative values set future countdown cycle.
nodes.example: Remaining Seconds 0, Max Seconds 5: triggers skill next frame, then uses 5 seconds for future cycles.
nodes.warning: Only affects skills that use attribute countdowns; does not change normal attack intervals.

nodes.purpose: Reads current attribute countdown and maximum seconds for a plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant object; returns current countdown and max seconds.
nodes.example: Use to create attribute cooldown UI text or trigger conditional rules.
nodes.warning: If no custom cycle was set and there is no progress bar, current countdown is returned as max seconds.

nodes.purpose: Directly attempts to trigger a plant's Golden Coffee Bean Super Skill.
nodes.usage: Connect target plant and trigger.
nodes.example: Clicking a designated plant attempts to activate its Super Skill for free.
nodes.warning: Calls SuperSkill directly without consuming coins, upgrading silver plants, or generating coin-spending procs. Routes to failure if plant has no super skill or cannot currently activate it.

nodes.purpose: Upgrades a designated plant or grants Star Power effect.
nodes.usage: Calls native plant upgrade or plugin enhancement logic.
nodes.example: Target Tier 2, Plugin False -> Upgrades plant to Tier 2 for free.
nodes.warning: Target tier 0 - 3 must be higher than current tier. If Star Power is true, calls StarUp; only succeeds on plants supporting Star Power.

nodes.purpose: Sets base HP, max HP, attack power, armor HP, base speed, or scale for a zombie.
nodes.usage: Select stat to modify from dropdown, connect zombie object and enter value.
nodes.example: Select Base Speed, enter 2.0; Chill speed multipliers still apply on top.
nodes.warning: Setting base HP to 0 triggers normal death. Armor setting only affects existing armor. Scale is clamped between 0.1 and 5.0; speed is clamped between 0 and 100.

nodes.purpose: Reads base HP, max HP, attack power, armor HP, base speed, or scale of a zombie.
nodes.usage: Select stat and connect zombie object; base HP does not include armors.
nodes.example: Select Base HP -> Float Compare (Less Than 100).
nodes.warning: If object is null or type mismatches, outputs failure / default values.
