nodes.purpose: Reads the current coins in the active lawn match.
nodes.usage: Connect output to comparisons or variable setters.
nodes.example: Coins >= 1000 unlocks reward choices.
nodes.warning: Reads match coins for the current board; does not read or modify profile shop currency.

nodes.purpose: Adds a zombie card to the current card slot, with optional price and cooldown.
nodes.usage: Enter price, cooldown seconds, and IsReady flag; connect trigger input.
nodes.example: Regular Zombie, Cost 50, Cooldown 5s, IsReady=True.
nodes.warning: Cost/Cooldown -1 reads level zombie defaults. Routes to failure if card slots are full or unavailable.

nodes.purpose: Deletes all zombie cards of the specified type from the current card slot.
nodes.usage: Select zombie type and trigger to delete.
nodes.example: Delete all Conehead Zombie cards.
nodes.warning: Supports regular card bar and I, Zombie card bar. Gallery cards not selected into card bar are not deleted. Completes normally even if 0 cards are deleted.

nodes.purpose: Deletes all info cards, or a single info card corresponding to the input object.
nodes.usage: Delete all info cards or connect card object with All=False.
nodes.example: Connect created info card object to this node with All=False.
nodes.warning: If no object is connected and All is False, 0 cards are deleted to prevent accidental deletion.

nodes.purpose: Modifies the total cooldown and remaining cooldown of matching zombie cards in the current card slot.
nodes.usage: Select zombie type; enter total seconds and remaining seconds.
nodes.example: Total 10s, Remaining 0s -> Instantly ready, then 10s cooldown on each subsequent use.
nodes.warning: Remaining seconds cannot exceed total seconds. Only affects existing cards in the slot.

nodes.purpose: Selects a tool type for queries, cooldowns, and comparison nodes.
nodes.usage: Select tool type from dropdown; connect output to tool-related nodes.
nodes.example: Select Glove, connect to Set Tool Cooldown.
nodes.warning: Plant preview, zombie preview, coffee bean, etc., can be recognized as held types, but do not have tool cooldowns.

nodes.purpose: Gets the item object and tool type currently held by the mouse cursor.
nodes.usage: Identifies shovel, glove, hammer, bucket, cannon crosshair, etc., outputting item object and tool type.
nodes.example: Tool Type output connects to Compare Tool Type to check if holding Glove.
nodes.warning: Returns 'None' and null object if empty-handed.

nodes.purpose: Checks whether two tool types are identical.
nodes.usage: Connect two tool types to inputs; output boolean connects to branch conditions.
nodes.example: Held Tool Type compares with 'Glove' constant.
nodes.warning: Null or invalid inputs return False.

nodes.purpose: Modifies the cooldown of shovel, glove, hammer, or lawnmower in this match.
nodes.usage: Select tool type, enter total cooldown and remaining cooldown seconds.
nodes.example: Glove, Total 5s, Remaining 0s -> Instantly available.
nodes.warning: Total seconds setting lasts until the tool is destroyed; remaining seconds only changes the current cooldown cycle. No Cooldown mode or IZ free cooldown rules take priority.

nodes.purpose: Reads the total cooldown, remaining cooldown, and existence of the specified tool.
nodes.usage: Select tool type; output provides total seconds, remaining seconds, and Exists boolean.
nodes.example: Read Glove remaining seconds and convert to text for display.
nodes.warning: Returns 0 and Exists=False if tool does not exist.

nodes.purpose: Checks condition at specified intervals, continuing execution flow once condition becomes true.
nodes.usage: Checks immediately once, then checks at each interval; True triggers Completed, False continues waiting. Reaching max check count routes to Timeout. Re-triggering replaces previous wait.
nodes.example: Int Variable >= 10 connects to Condition, Interval 0.2s; continues when variable reaches 10.
nodes.warning: Failed output indicates invalid parameters (e.g. interval < 0.1s); False condition does not trigger Failed. Exiting level or changing stage cancels waiting.

nodes.purpose: Repeatedly executes an action until condition becomes true, then continues subsequent flow.
nodes.usage: Checks immediately once; False triggers 'Loop', then waits specified interval before checking again; True triggers 'Completed'. Reaching max checks routes to Timeout.
nodes.example: Condition connects to Int Variable >= 10; Loop connects to Variable + 1, interval 0.2s; Completed once 10 is reached.
nodes.warning: Failed indicates invalid parameters (e.g. interval < 0.1s). Exiting level or changing phase cancels loop.

nodes.purpose: Triggers when an alive zombie is left-clicked on the lawn board.
nodes.usage: Trigger output starts actions; zombie output provides the clicked target zombie.
nodes.example: Trigger -> Damage Zombie; target zombie connects to Zombie input to create click-to-damage gameplay.
nodes.warning: Only queries colliders on valid battlefield clicks; selects nearest zombie if overlapping. Does not intercept normal card or tool placement.

nodes.purpose: Listens for full-screen Ice-shroom or single-row Jalapeno effects.
nodes.usage: Select effect from dropdown; Row output indicates row of effect (-1 for full-screen).
nodes.example: Select Jalapeno; Row output connects to spawn or cleanup nodes.
nodes.warning: Ice-shroom is full-screen, returning Row=-1. Listens to both plant actions and node calls; avoid triggering the same effect recursively.

nodes.purpose: Controls whether zombies entering the house trigger the default defeat game-over.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger and set Defeat On House flag.
nodes.example: Level Start -> Set Zombie House Rule (Defeat = False); customize win/loss via visual scripting.
nodes.warning: Only modifies the house breach trigger; other defeat sources (e.g., protected plant dies, manual quit) remain unchanged. Disabled zombies keep walking and despawn past the left border.

nodes.purpose: Pauses automatic countdown to the next wave; already spawned zombies continue acting.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger and set Paused flag.
nodes.example: Dialogue starts -> Set Wave Countdown Paused (True); Dialogue ends -> Set Paused (False).
nodes.warning: Pauses wave timer and low-health early spawns; does not stop zombies already spawning in current wave. Auto-resumes when event graph stops.

nodes.purpose: Deletes graves, craters, ladders, or ice blocks from the specified grid tile.
nodes.usage: Select obstacle type; enter row and column coordinates.
nodes.example: Select Crater, Row 2, Column 3 -> Removes crater at that tile.
nodes.warning: Calls Die logic and clears grid occupation. 'Ice Block' refers to tile ice blocks, not Zomboni ice trails. 0-indexed rows and columns.

nodes.purpose: Plays selected in-game background music.
nodes.usage: Select music track from dropdown and connect trigger.
nodes.example: Phase Enter event -> Change Event Music; selects battle BGM for that phase.
nodes.warning: Only uses loaded in-game tracks. Do not call every frame to avoid restarting track repeatedly.

nodes.purpose: Removes a specified Travel modifier in this match, stopping ongoing effects and refreshing synergies.
nodes.usage: Select modifier category; enter internal name, ID, or localized display title.
nodes.example: Select Zombie Modifier, enter 'Unstoppable' to remove the modifier.
nodes.warning: Unregisters listener and stops continuous cycles. Synergies and buffs update dynamically. Handed-out resources or cards are not revoked.

nodes.purpose: Recursively unpacks a fusion plant formula, outputting a list of basic component plant types.
nodes.usage: Connect plant type input; output provides list of base plant types.
nodes.example: Input Fusion Plant -> For Each Plant Type to inspect ingredients; duplicate components are preserved.
nodes.warning: Uses static fusion recipes, not randomized mutation history. Returns self if plant has no fusion recipe.

nodes.purpose: Combines three floats into a 3D world coordinate vector.
nodes.usage: Connect X, Y, Z float values; output connects to position inputs.
nodes.example: X=0, Y=1, Z=0 -> Position port of Create Event Object.
nodes.warning: Invalid numbers return default Vector3.zero.

nodes.purpose: Reads the mouse cursor's world position and corresponding grid tile on the lawn board.
nodes.usage: Output provides Vector3 position, Row, and Column.
nodes.example: Position connects to Create Event Object; Row/Column connect to grid actions.
nodes.warning: Row and Column may be out of bounds if mouse is outside the lawn board.

nodes.purpose: Creates a lightweight empty object managed by the event graph, with optional plant icon decoration.
nodes.usage: Select decorative plant icon and enter world position; output provides object reference.
nodes.example: Select Peashooter icon, create decorative marker at mouse position.
nodes.warning: Scene marker only; does not perform attacks or occupy grid tiles. Maximum 256 alive objects per graph; cleaned up when graph exits.

nodes.purpose: Saves an object reference by name for later event retrieval.
nodes.usage: Connect object reference, enter name string, and trigger.
nodes.example: Name 'Marker1' -> Retrieve later via String to Object.
nodes.warning: Reusing existing name overwrites previous binding. Name is only valid within current graph run. Pooled bullets cannot be bound as persistent objects.

nodes.purpose: Generates a unique runtime reference token string for an object.
nodes.usage: Connect object; output string provides runtime reference token.
nodes.example: Store object reference string in a String List, then resolve later with String to Object.
nodes.warning: Token is a runtime reference, not an object name or persistent save ID. Returns empty string for invalid/destroyed objects.

nodes.purpose: Resolves an object from its runtime reference string or bound object name.
nodes.usage: Enter reference string or bound name; output provides object reference.
nodes.example: String 'Marker1' -> Resolves object saved with Bind Object.
nodes.warning: Returns null if expired, destroyed, or from a different match.

nodes.purpose: Converts a plant instance into a generic scene object reference.
nodes.usage: Connect plant input; output provides object reference.
nodes.example: Use for object binding, object lists, or reading transform coordinates.
nodes.warning: Returns null if plant is null or destroyed.

nodes.purpose: Retrieves the Plant component from a scene object.
nodes.usage: Connect object input; output provides plant instance.
nodes.example: Retrieve item from Object List -> Object to Plant -> Combat Action.
nodes.warning: Returns null if object has no plant component or is invalid.

nodes.purpose: Converts a zombie instance into a generic scene object reference.
nodes.usage: Connect zombie input; output provides object reference.
nodes.example: Use for object binding, object lists, or reading transform coordinates.
nodes.warning: Returns null if zombie is null or destroyed.

nodes.purpose: Retrieves the Zombie component from a scene object.
nodes.usage: Connect object input; output provides zombie instance.
nodes.example: Retrieve item from Object List -> Object to Zombie -> Combat Action.
nodes.warning: Returns null if object has no zombie component or is invalid.

nodes.purpose: Reads the world position, scale, and existence state of an object.
nodes.usage: Connect object input; output provides Position Vector3, Scale Vector3, and Exists boolean.
nodes.example: Read plant position as spawn coordinate for decorative markers.
nodes.warning: Returns default zero vectors and Exists=False if object is null.

nodes.purpose: Moves and scales decorative marker objects created by Create Event Object.
nodes.usage: Connect event object, enter new Position and Scale multiplier.
nodes.example: Move marker to mouse position with Scale 0.5.
nodes.warning: Only affects decorative objects created by the event graph. For plants/zombies use dedicated move nodes.

nodes.purpose: Destroys a scene marker object created by the current event graph.
nodes.usage: Connect event object and trigger to destroy.
nodes.example: Destroy temporary bound marker when phase completes.
nodes.warning: Only allowed for event graph-owned objects. For plants/zombies/cards use their native removal nodes.

nodes.purpose: Selects an in-game bullet type.
nodes.usage: Select bullet type from dropdown; output connects to bullet nodes.
nodes.example: Bullet_pea is regular pea; same bullet type can be fired by plants or custom sources.
nodes.warning: Fails to shoot if resources are unloaded. Projectiles fly in straight lines at specified angles.

nodes.purpose: Fires a bullet in a given direction from a specified grid tile or mouse position.
nodes.usage: Connect bullet type; enter row, column, damage, speed, angle, and scale.
nodes.example: Row 2, Col 3.5, Damage 20, Speed 6, Angle 0 (Right), Scale 1.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed rows/columns. Angle 0 is Right, 90 Up, 180 Left, 270 Down. Recycled when leaving screen or after 20s.

nodes.purpose: Modifies scale, speed, damage, or direction of an active event bullet.
nodes.usage: Select property to modify, connect bullet handle and enter new value.
nodes.example: Select Angle, Value 90 -> Turns bullet upward.
nodes.warning: Routes to failure if bullet has already despawned or been recycled.

nodes.purpose: Switches Day/Night background within compatible terrain, preserving board entities and ice trails.
nodes.usage: Select target map stage; triggers background transition.
nodes.example: Phase event in Day map -> Select Night -> Transitions map to Night.
nodes.warning: Supports Day/Night, Day_6/Night_6, Pool/NightPool, Roof/NightRoof, Travel Roof phases, Travel Pool phases, SnowPool Day/Night. At least 1s cooldown. Does not alter sun, entities, waves, or speed.

nodes.purpose: Sequentially processes every alive zombie currently on the lawn board.
nodes.usage: Connect trigger; 'Loop' output triggers for each zombie, providing current zombie object.
nodes.example: Loop -> Apply Zombie Status; Target Zombie connects to Zombie input.
nodes.warning: Takes snapshot upon trigger; zombies spawned during loop are processed in next trigger. Dead zombies are skipped. Includes charmed zombies.

nodes.purpose: Sets the base attack interval of a designated plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant and enter interval in seconds.
nodes.example: Enter 0.5s -> Plant base delay between attacks becomes 0.5 seconds.
nodes.warning: Allowed range: 0.05 to 3600 seconds. Attack speed buffs still scale on top. Only affects plants using base attack interval.

nodes.purpose: Invokes the native Golden Coffee Bean feeding sequence on a plant.
nodes.usage: Connect plant and trigger; 'Success' output indicates whether feeding succeeded.
nodes.example: Trigger -> Feed Golden Bean; checks Success output to confirm.
nodes.warning: Does not require player to pick up bean. Honors coin cost, upgradeable types, and super skill conditions.

nodes.purpose: References a shared string variable from the Level Variables panel.
nodes.usage: Create string variable in Level Variables panel and drag to canvas; connects to Get or Set String Variable.
nodes.example: String Variable -> Get String -> Display Text.
nodes.warning: Dragging same variable multiple times shares value. Template insertion creates independent copy.

nodes.purpose: References a shared typed list from the Level Variables panel.
nodes.usage: Create list in Level Variables panel, choose element type, fill initial values, then drag to canvas.
nodes.example: Integer List -> List Length; Trigger -> Append to list -> Read length again.
nodes.warning: 0-indexed, max 512 items. Element type must match operating node.
